This script creates euler diagrams to visualize the overlap and differences in diversity between larvae and adults in each aquatic insect assessed

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE} knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list = ls()) # Clean environment

library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(eulerr)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)


output_dir <- "R_output/Vertically_Transmitted_Taxa/Euler_plots"
if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
load("R_output/ps_objects/GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_unnorm.RData")

```

Prepare Data

```{r}

# prep  data
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_final), "matrix")
if(!taxa_are_rows(ps_final)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_final)) %>%
  filter(Lifestage %in% c("Larvae", "Adult"))  # remove spiders

otu_mat <- otu_mat[, rownames(meta)]

# function to create euler
plot_taxon_euler <- function(taxon_name, otu_mat, meta){

  meta_taxon <- meta %>% filter(Taxa == taxon_name)

  larva_samples <- rownames(meta_taxon[meta_taxon$Lifestage=="Larvae",])
  adult_samples <- rownames(meta_taxon[meta_taxon$Lifestage=="Adult",])

  if(length(larva_samples)==0 | length(adult_samples)==0) return(NULL)

  otu_larva <- otu_mat[, larva_samples, drop=FALSE]
  otu_adult <- otu_mat[, adult_samples, drop=FALSE]

  taxa_larva <- rownames(otu_larva)[rowSums(otu_larva) > 0]
  taxa_adult <- rownames(otu_adult)[rowSums(otu_adult) > 0]

  n_larva <- length(taxa_larva)
  n_adult <- length(taxa_adult)
  n_overlap <- length(intersect(taxa_larva, taxa_adult))

  if(n_larva == 0 & n_adult == 0) return(NULL)

  # Create Euler object
  fit <- euler(c(
    Larva = n_larva - n_overlap,     # use "Larva" for display
    Adult  = n_adult - n_overlap,
    "Larva&Adult" = n_overlap
  ))

  # labels with number + percentage (percentages below numbers)
  total_combined <- n_larva + n_adult - n_overlap
  labels <- c(
    paste0(format(n_larva - n_overlap, big.mark=","), "\n(", round((n_larva - n_overlap)/total_combined*100,1), "%)"),
    paste0(format(n_adult - n_overlap, big.mark=","), "\n(", round((n_adult - n_overlap)/total_combined*100,1), "%)"),
    paste0(format(n_overlap, big.mark=","), "\n(", round(n_overlap/total_combined*100,1), "%)")
  )

  # plot
  v <- plot(fit,
       quantities = list(fontsize=12, fontface=3, labels=labels, col="black"), # numbers smaller & italic
       fills = list(fill = c("#88C6ED", "#EF4442"), alpha = 0.6),
       labels = list(col="black", font=2),
       main = NULL
  )

  #  black title above diagram with less space
  title_grob <- textGrob(taxon_name, gp=gpar(fontsize=16, fontface="bold", col="black"))
  arranged <- arrangeGrob(title_grob, v, ncol=1, heights=c(0.06, 0.94))

  return(arranged)
}


```

Create plots

```{r}
# diagram for all taxa
taxa_list <- unique(meta$Taxa)

euler_list <- lapply(taxa_list, function(taxon) plot_taxon_euler(taxon, otu_mat, meta))
euler_list <- euler_list[!sapply(euler_list, is.null)]

# arrange in grid (3columns)
grid.arrange_grid <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(euler_list, ncol=3, padding=unit(1.5, "lines")))


```

Save files

```{r}

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "Euler_Taxa.pdf"), width=12, height=12/3)
do.call(grid.arrange, c(euler_list, ncol=3, padding=unit(1.5, "lines")))
dev.off()


png(file.path(output_dir, "Euler_Taxa.png"), width=3500, height=3500/3, res=300)
do.call(grid.arrange, c(euler_list, ncol=3, padding=unit(1.5, "lines")))
dev.off()

```

Include Spiders

```{r}

load("R_output/ps_objects/GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_unnorm.RData")

# prep
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_final), "matrix")
if(!taxa_are_rows(ps_final)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_final)) %>%
  filter(Lifestage %in% c("Larvae", "Adult"))  # exclude spiders here first

otu_mat <- otu_mat[, rownames(meta)]

# func tion
plot_taxon_euler <- function(taxon_name, otu_mat, meta){

  meta_taxon <- meta %>% filter(Taxa == taxon_name)

  larva_samples <- rownames(meta_taxon[meta_taxon$Lifestage=="Larvae",])
  adult_samples <- rownames(meta_taxon[meta_taxon$Lifestage=="Adult",])

  if(length(larva_samples)==0 | length(adult_samples)==0) return(NULL)

  otu_larva <- otu_mat[, larva_samples, drop=FALSE]
  otu_adult <- otu_mat[, adult_samples, drop=FALSE]

  taxa_larva <- rownames(otu_larva)[rowSums(otu_larva) > 0]
  taxa_adult <- rownames(otu_adult)[rowSums(otu_adult) > 0]

  n_larva <- length(taxa_larva)
  n_adult <- length(taxa_adult)
  n_overlap <- length(intersect(taxa_larva, taxa_adult))

  if(n_larva == 0 & n_adult == 0) return(NULL)

  # Create Euler object
  fit <- euler(c(
    Larva = n_larva - n_overlap,
    Adult  = n_adult - n_overlap,
    "Larva&Adult" = n_overlap
  ))

  # labels with number + percentage
  total_combined <- n_larva + n_adult - n_overlap
  labels <- c(
    paste0(format(n_larva - n_overlap, big.mark=","), "\n(", round((n_larva - n_overlap)/total_combined*100,1), "%)"),
    paste0(format(n_adult - n_overlap, big.mark=","), "\n(", round((n_adult - n_overlap)/total_combined*100,1), "%)"),
    paste0(format(n_overlap, big.mark=","), "\n(", round(n_overlap/total_combined*100,1), "%)")
  )

  # plot
  v <- plot(fit,
       quantities = list(fontsize=12, fontface=3, labels=labels, col="black"),
       fills = list(fill = c("#88C6ED", "#EF4442"), alpha = 0.6),
       labels = list(col="black", font=2),
       main = NULL
  )

  # title above diagram
  title_grob <- textGrob(taxon_name, gp=gpar(fontsize=16, fontface="bold", col="black"))
  arranged <- arrangeGrob(title_grob, v, ncol=1, heights=c(0.06, 0.94))

  return(arranged)
}


taxa_list <- unique(meta$Taxa)
euler_list <- lapply(taxa_list, function(taxon) plot_taxon_euler(taxon, otu_mat, meta))
euler_list <- euler_list[!sapply(euler_list, is.null)]


output_dir <- "R_output/Vertically_Transmitted_Taxa/Euler_plots"
if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "Euler_Taxa_Larva_Adult.pdf"), width=12, height=12/3)
do.call(grid.arrange, c(euler_list, ncol=3, padding=unit(1.5, "lines")))
dev.off()

png(file.path(output_dir, "Euler_Taxa_Larva_Adult.png"), width=3500, height=3500/3, res=300)
do.call(grid.arrange, c(euler_list, ncol=3, padding=unit(1.5, "lines")))
dev.off()


meta_spider <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_final)) %>%
  filter(Lifestage %in% c("Larvae", "Adult", "Spider"))
otu_mat_spider <- otu_mat[, rownames(meta_spider), drop=FALSE]

plot_taxon_euler3 <- function(taxon_name, otu_mat, meta){

  meta_taxon <- meta %>% filter(Taxa == taxon_name)

  larva_samples <- rownames(meta_taxon[meta_taxon$Lifestage=="Larvae",])
  adult_samples <- rownames(meta_taxon[meta_taxon$Lifestage=="Adult",])
  spider_samples <- rownames(meta_taxon[meta_taxon$Lifestage=="Spider",])

  if(any(lengths(list(larva_samples, adult_samples, spider_samples)) == 0)) return(NULL)

  otu_larva <- otu_mat[, larva_samples, drop=FALSE]
  otu_adult <- otu_mat[, adult_samples, drop=FALSE]
  otu_spider <- otu_mat[, spider_samples, drop=FALSE]

  taxa_larva <- rownames(otu_larva)[rowSums(otu_larva) > 0]
  taxa_adult <- rownames(otu_adult)[rowSums(otu_adult) > 0]
  taxa_spider <- rownames(otu_spider)[rowSums(otu_spider) > 0]

  sets <- list(
    Larva = taxa_larva,
    Adult = taxa_adult,
    Spider = taxa_spider
  )

  fit <- euler(sets)

  # Plot with same style
  v <- plot(fit,
       quantities = list(fontsize=10, fontface=3, col="black"),
       fills = list(fill = c("#88C6ED", "#EF4442", "#22C55E"), alpha = 0.6),
       labels = list(col="black", font=2),
       main = NULL
  )

  title_grob <- textGrob(taxon_name, gp=gpar(fontsize=16, fontface="bold", col="black"))
  arranged <- arrangeGrob(title_grob, v, ncol=1, heights=c(0.06, 0.94))

  return(arranged)
}

# Create and save 3-group Euler diagrams
euler_list3 <- lapply(taxa_list, function(taxon) plot_taxon_euler3(taxon, otu_mat_spider, meta_spider))
euler_list3 <- euler_list3[!sapply(euler_list3, is.null)]

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "Euler_Taxa_Larva_Adult_Spider.pdf"), width=12, height=12/3)
do.call(grid.arrange, c(euler_list3, ncol=3, padding=unit(1.5, "lines")))
dev.off()

png(file.path(output_dir, "Euler_Taxa_Larva_Adult_Spider.png"), width=3500, height=3500/3, res=300)
do.call(grid.arrange, c(euler_list3, ncol=3, padding=unit(1.5, "lines")))
dev.off()

```
